title: Percona: backup restore round-trip
description: Runs `nexus backup restore percona <id>`: finds the node holding the dump, strips USE/CREATE DATABASE, restores into a nexus_restore_verify schema (non-destructive), and counts restored rows.

observe.what: items restored >= 1 (the galera_init_test row), restored into nexus_restore_verify

whatProves: PerconaAdapter.BackupRestoreAsync round-trips the logical dump end-to-end. Replace the id with one from `backup take`.
